name: Status Strip
job: Say in one line where the work stands: not started and what is next, or which day it is, how many hours are done and what waits on the reader.

anatomy.role: Bold `Not started.` before any progress; never an empty 0% bar
One 18px segment per plan day; done days filled, today half filled; `role=progressbar`
`Day N · X of Y hours done`, tabular figures
Bold key then value: `Up next:`, `Ready for your review:`, `Comments so far:`
A `details` disclosure, only when something sits behind it (working on now, waiting on, latest)

states.name: Not started
states.note: `Not started.` plus `Up next:`. No bar and no Details.

states.name: In progress
states.note: Day segments, `Day 2 · 6 of 16 hours done`, review and comments count, and Details because something is waiting.

use_when: A plan has days and hours and the reader wants to know, at a glance, where it stands and whether anything waits on them.
Show progress only once there is some; before that, `Not started.` and `Up next` say more than a 0% bar.
Placement: directly under the wordmark row and above the header strip, on every tab, with `.is-top` (one step smaller than the body text). It is engagement-wide status, not part of one tab's content.
avoid_when: Do not show an empty bar, a percent, or a Details toggle with nothing behind it.
Do not repeat what the Now note above already says; the strip is the facts, the note is the action.

data.note: Plan day labels, such as `Before`, `Day 1` to `Day 5`, `After`; one segment each.
Index of today in `days`; absent means not started.
Rendered as `X of Y hours done`.
The next item, shown as `Up next:`.
Items ready for the reader, with the date they became ready.
Count of comments batched for the next review call.
Lines behind Details: working on now, waiting on, latest. No Details when empty.

access: A labelled `section` with a visually hidden heading (Where things stand).
Segments carry `role=progressbar` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` and an `aria-valuetext` that reads the day and hours.
Meaning never rests on colour: the day and hours are also written out.
Details is a native `details`/`summary`, 44px tall. Text is rem, so the reading options scale it.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check` (in scripts): every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
